## Change summary

What changed, and which files, learners, or research case does it affect?

## Review checklist

- [ ] Branch targets `main`; unrelated modifications and generated outputs were excluded.
- [ ] Local links, commands, tests and relevant GitHub Actions checks were reviewed.
- [ ] No secrets, keys, participant-linked records, controlled inputs, or unapproved source data are included.
- [ ] New or modified models state whether outputs are synthetic, descriptive, externally validated, or unverified.
- [ ] A frozen scientific protocol was not silently changed to accommodate observed results; amendments have an independent version and review.
- [ ] Evidence claims cite the actual execution and independent review, not simply a proposed or draft workflow.
- [ ] PR does not silently change G4/G5 or D0/D1 milestone/admission statuses.
- [ ] Navigation and contributor guidance are updated for new or renamed entrypoints.

**Checks actually executed:** (commands, commit SHA, CI URLs; explicitly name those not run)

**Data/privacy status:** (synthetic only / external data proposed / separately authorized source; do not include secrets or identifiable data)

**Unresolved risks or reviewers needed:**

See [contribution rules](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [gate evidence policy](../docs/roadmap-gates.md).
